plan.understanding: Reprofile all four separate diagonal link-arm plates as constant-width obround (long-hole-shaped) profiles for greater stiffness, and enlarge each arm’s three existing axial holes from 5.0 mm to 6.0 mm while retaining their measured centers.

subtasks.goal: Edit only the imported solid uniquely identified by bbox Z=23.004..25.004 mm and three Z-axis d=5.0 bores at XY [-37.304,44.606], [2.720,23.179], and [42.743,1.753] (the negative-slope arm currently measured as s0, volume 912.161 mm^3). Isolate this solid from the compound before any Boolean operation; do not select the coincident Z=25.004 interface or operate on all touching bodies. If a view anchor is needed, use its lower planar face at world Z=23.004 as seen from the back (-Z) side and confirm the three bore coordinates before editing. Create an additive capsule/obround prism whose semicircle centers are [-37.304,44.606] and [42.743,1.753], whose radius is 4.9 mm (overall width 9.8 mm), and whose extrusion is exactly world Z=23.004..25.004. Fuse this tool only into the isolated imported solid; the measured existing r=4.4/narrow-sided footprint is enclosed by the new capsule, so this additive edit replaces the exposed profile without constructing an unrelated output body. Then subtract three concentric d=6.0 cylinders along measured axis [0,0,1], through Z=23.004..25.004, at the two endpoint centers and midpoint [2.720,23.179]. Replace only the original s0 member of the assembly with this Boolean result and reassemble the other 11 solids unchanged; in particular, the positive-slope solid at Z=25.004..27.004 (s8), the negative-slope solid at Z=-23.996..-21.996 (s9), and the positive-slope solid at Z=-25.996..-23.996 (s10) must remain untouched. Do not retain the capsule or cutting cylinders as separate bodies. Verify and report endpoint centers, all three hole centers, 9.8 mm width, 2.000 mm Z thickness, d=6.0 bores, and major-axis angle atan2(1.753-44.606,42.743-(-37.304)) approximately -28.16 degrees; correct the isolated s0 result before reassembly if any value differs.

On body s8, replace the existing narrow-sided arm profile identified by planar side faces #138,#140,#151,#153 and outer r=4.4 cylindrical end regions faces #139,#141,#152,#158 with one constant-width obround profile along the measured line from center [-37.304,1.753] through [2.720,23.179] to [42.743,44.606] in the XY plane. Use a 9.8 mm overall profile width with r=4.9 mm semicircular ends centered on the two end-hole axes, preserve the Z thickness from 25.004 to 27.004 mm, and enlarge all three red d=5.0 mm bores (faces #155,#156,#157; edge_idx [291,292,293,317,318,319]) concentrically to d=6.0 mm along measured axis [0,0,1]. The obround major axis must be clocked approximately +28.16 degrees from +X; print the achieved endpoint centers, hole centers, width, and major-axis angle and correct them in the same attempt if they differ from these values.

On body s9, replace the existing narrow-sided arm profile identified by planar side faces #167,#169,#180,#182 and outer r=4.4 cylindrical end regions faces #168,#170,#181,#187 with one constant-width obround profile along the measured line from center [-37.304,44.606] through [2.720,23.179] to [42.743,1.753] in the XY plane. Use a 9.8 mm overall profile width with r=4.9 mm semicircular ends centered on the two end-hole axes, preserve the Z thickness from -23.996 to -21.996 mm, and enlarge the three existing d=5.0 mm through-holes identified by the three inner loops of faces #171 and #183 (edge_idx [356,357,358,382,383,384]) concentrically to d=6.0 mm along measured axis [0,0,1]. The obround major axis must be clocked approximately -28.16 degrees from +X; print the achieved endpoint centers, hole centers, width, and major-axis angle and correct them in the same attempt if they differ from these values.

Edit only body s10, identified as the 2.000 mm-thick lower arm occupying Z=-25.996 to -23.996 mm and containing three d=5.0 mm Z-axis bores at XY=[-37.304,1.753], [2.720,23.179], and [42.743,44.606]. Re-anchor the construction to its +Z planar face at Z=-23.996 mm, viewed from the front (+Z) direction; do not derive orientation from the back view, whose projection reverses the apparent left-right slope. In global XY coordinates, construct a closed capsule from r=4.9 mm circles centered at [-37.304,1.753] and [42.743,44.606], joined by their common tangent lines, and extrude it exactly from Z=-25.996 to -23.996 mm. Boolean-union this capsule with the imported s10 body; the measured existing r=4.4 end regions and narrow sides lie within the new capsule, so this adds the required stiffness material without deleting or reconstructing unrelated bodies. After the union, cut three concentric through-cylinders of d=6.0 mm along measured axis [0,0,1] at the two endpoint centers and the intermediate center [2.720,23.179], spanning the full measured s10 thickness. Keep s9 unchanged: it is the other diagonal candidate, running through [-37.304,44.606], [2.720,23.179], and [42.743,1.753], and it already has a 9.8 mm profile and d=6.0 holes. Numerically report and verify the edited s10 endpoint centers, all three hole centers, Z limits, width 9.8 mm, hole diameter 6.0 mm, and global major-axis angle atan2(44.606-1.753,42.743-(-37.304)) approximately +28.16 degrees; correct the global-coordinate construction before completion if any value differs.
